description: Use to change a watch's settings. Only the fields given change. Confirm first. kind flight or hotel: the alert rule, a target price, the email and text channels, and a stay's name. seat: pause or resume, the seats-together rule, channels; to watch different seats call track_seats again (it adds to the alert). bucket_list: the price bar, months or date window, nights, stops, airlines, preferred weekdays, travelers, name, guests, stars, channels, and a flight list's filters (airlines left out, connecting airports, times, duration, layovers, emissions, bags); a filter given replaces the stored one, clear_filters names the ones to remove, and a changed search resets the deals found so far.

airlines.description: [bucket_list] Only these marketing carriers, as IATA codes or names.

alert_rule.description: [flight, hotel] When to alert: lowest = only a new low, any = every price move, none = off. Empty: the default; or give target_price_usd instead.

alerts_on.description: [seat] false pauses the alert, true resumes it.

arrive_after.description: [bucket_list] HH:MM, local time at that airport.

arrive_before.description: [bucket_list] HH:MM, local time at that airport.

carry_on_bags.description: [bucket_list] Carry-on bags per traveler; every day's price then includes the bag fees.

check_in_days.description: [bucket_list] Hotel lists: only check in on these weekdays.

checked_bags.description: [bucket_list] Checked bags per traveler; fees are priced only for flights within the US and Canada (elsewhere the answer says they are not included). Every day's price then includes them.

clear_window.description: [bucket_list] Remove the date window and watch the months instead.

connecting_airports.description: [bucket_list] Only itineraries that change planes at these airports (codes or city codes), nonstops included: for 'US connections only' name the hubs.

currency.description: [flight, hotel, bucket_list] The traveler's currency, when they name one or their words show where they live (euros in Spain, or writing in French from Lyon). Empty: US dollars or their SlickTrip currency. Amounts you send stay US dollars.

depart_after.description: [bucket_list] HH:MM, local time at that airport.

depart_before.description: [bucket_list] HH:MM, local time at that airport.

depart_days.description: [bucket_list] Flight lists: only depart on these weekdays.

email.description: [every kind] Send alerts by email. Empty keeps the account's setting.

exclude_airlines.description: [bucket_list] Leave out itineraries with any flight sold by these carriers (IATA codes, names or an alliance), by flight number or airline name: for 'not Gol' or 'avoid Air India'.

exclude_connecting_airports.description: [bucket_list] Leave out itineraries that change planes at these airports (codes or city codes).

kind.description: The watch's kind: flight (a tracked route), hotel (a tracked stay), seat (a seat alert) or bucket_list (a flight or hotel bucket list).

lower_emissions.description: [bucket_list] Only itineraries with lower emissions than is typical for the route.

max_duration_hours.description: [bucket_list] Longest itinerary to show, in hours.

max_layover_hours.description: [bucket_list] Longest layover allowed at every connection, in hours (half hours allowed): for 'layovers no longer than 5 hours'.

max_nights.description: [bucket_list] Flight lists: longest trip. Hotel lists: the stay length.

max_price_usd.description: [bucket_list] The price bar, USD: per traveler for a flight list (total when price_is_total), per night for a hotel list.

max_stops.description: [bucket_list] Most stops allowed: 0 nonstop, 1, or 2 (2 or more: any number).

min_layover_hours.description: [bucket_list] Shortest layover allowed at every connection, in hours (half hours allowed): for 'at least 2 hours to connect'.

min_nights.description: [bucket_list] Flight lists: shortest trip. Hotel lists: the stay length.

months.description: [bucket_list] Months to watch, as names or YYYY-MM. Give this OR start_date + end_date.

name.description: [hotel, bucket_list] Rename it: the stay, as it appears on the saved-hotels page, or a flight bucket list's label (a hotel bucket list has no name).

price_is_total.description: [bucket_list] Flight lists: max_price_usd is the total for all travelers.

return_days.description: [bucket_list] Flight lists: only return on these weekdays.

seats_together.description: [seat] Alert only when this many seats are open together, 2-6; 0 clears the rule.

target_price_usd.description: [flight, hotel] Alert when the price goes under this, USD; replaces alert_rule. The TOTAL: the whole trip for all travelers (flight), the whole stay (hotel).

text.description: [every kind] Send alerts by text message (needs a verified phone on the account). Empty keeps the account's setting.

travelers.description: [bucket_list] Flight lists: how many travelers it watches for.

watch.description: The watch's id from watch_list: its search_key (flight), tracking_id (hotel), tracking_key (seat) or bucket_id (bucket_list).

name: watch_change

alerts_when.description: When alerts fire, from the alert preference

changed.description: Fields sent to the update handler, site vocabulary (price, stops, preferredMonths, ...)

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

display_name.description: Name as the card shows it

manage_url.description: flight: slicktrip.com saved-flights page link; hotel: slicktrip.com saved-hotels page link; bucket_list: slicktrip.com saved buckets page link

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

name.description: hotel: New stay name if renamed; bucket_list: The bucket's name (pre-update record)

note.description: flight: Text alerts need a verified phone; hotel: Text alerts need a verified phone; seat: Change seats via track_seats

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

route.description: Flight only: origin, destination, names, trip_type, cabin, travelers

stay.description: Hotel only: location, hotel_name, nights, adults

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

text_not_enabled.description: Text asked but no verified phone

title: Change a watch
